title: The Lust Wall Faced Freestanding Bath
bodyHtml:
Say hello to the all new Lust
Wall Faced Freestanding Bath

After countless requests from our Interior Designer partners, we are excited to present this variation of our contemporary freestanding bath 'Lust' designed and developed by Studio Bagno.

The Latest Edition to our Organic Collection

A new take on our best selling Lust bath, the Wall Faced variation retains the styling cues of our organic collection; sensuous curves, soft lines and crisp walls whilst adding practicality with it's easy to clean floating underskirt and junction with the wall, as well as increased functionality with the addition of the shelf.

Featuring a non-porous, anti-mildew surface, the Lust wall faced bath is available in Matte White, Semi Gloss White and Ash Grey.

What is a Freestanding Back to Wall Bath?

A back to wall freestanding bath or 'wall faced bath' is defined by one side of the bath being flush against a wall. They are still considered freestanding because they are installed without the need for panels or support, and they sit atop the floor unlike inset baths. The junction with the wall creates an excellent opportunity for additional function as it provides ample room for placement of bathroom necessities.

What is the Lust Wall Faced Freestanding Bath made from?

Lust is seamlessly fabricated from a blend of stone composite, composed of natural minerals and organic resins to create a surface that's quick to warm, retains water temperature longer and feels comforting against the skin.

Cleaning and Maintenance Guidance

The Lust Freestanding Wall Faced Bath is simple to keep clean. The design of the underskirt common across our organic range provides an easy to clean area where the bath meets the floor, but also serves as a way to keep the 'raised' visible area free from accidental marking. The stone composite itself contains anti-mildew technology making it harder for mould and other nasties to thrive, and it's non-porous nature means body products won't damage the surface.

For general cleaning advice, a warm water solution with a little biodegradable detergent is recommended. Simply buff with a clean dry cloth or paper towel. Should there be residue on the surface, make a paste of white vinegar and baking soda, rub gently, then rinse off with a solution. As above, then buff. For a heavy residue deposit use Gumption rubbing gently and then rinse with the detergent solution, then buff.
